title: ZeroDeck MVP-03 Website and Link Checking Product Requirements
scope: MVP-03 website and link checking for web and Android; bounded user-initiated URL checks, eligibility/no-call gates, URL and destination safety, provider interaction, privacy, results, failures, usage controls and platform semantics; excludes crawling and general network reconnaissance.

statements.text: The system MUST permit an MVP-03 provider-backed check only when the requesting account has an active Pro entitlement at the authorization point.
The system MUST permit an MVP-03 provider-backed check only when the owner-controlled activation switch is enabled.
The system MUST NOT make an external provider/API call unless both active Pro entitlement and enabled owner-controlled activation have been positively established for that request.
The system MUST apply an explicit usage policy to Pro link checking and MUST NOT represent Pro entitlement as unlimited usage.
The system MUST initiate an MVP-03 check only in response to an explicit user action on a supported URL input.
The system MUST identify the submitted target as one URL and MUST NOT imply that checking it inspected the entire website, linked pages, files, or other resources.
The system MUST reject empty, malformed, unsupported, or structurally ambiguous URL inputs before any provider request.
The system MUST preserve the submitted URL separately from any normalized lookup representation whenever normalization changes its representation.
statements.location: ### Requirement ZD-WEB-008 — Submitted and normalized identity

statements.text: The system MUST NOT transmit URL-embedded username or password credentials to a reputation provider as part of an MVP-03 lookup.
The system MUST prevent MVP-03 processing from causing an external fetch to loopback, private, link-local, reserved, multicast, metadata-service, or otherwise disallowed internal destinations.
The system MUST ensure destination restrictions remain effective when DNS answers change between validation and connection establishment.
The system MUST apply destination policy consistently to IPv4, IPv6, IPv4-mapped IPv6, alternate numeric representations, and internationalized hostnames.
The system MUST apply an explicit redirect policy and revalidate the destination and both MVP-03 gates before any subsequent outbound request caused by a redirect.
The system MUST NOT follow a redirect that downgrades a secure URL scheme to an insecure scheme unless a separately owner-approved policy explicitly permits it.
The system MUST treat TLS negotiation or certificate validation failure on any product-controlled provider connection as a failed lookup and MUST NOT silently disable certificate verification.
The system MUST disclose to an external provider only the URL representation and metadata required for the selected lookup operation, excluding account credentials and unrelated user data.
The system MUST treat submitted URLs, including paths and query parameters, as potentially sensitive user data.

The system MUST NOT place full submitted URLs, query strings, embedded credentials, or provider secrets in routine logs, analytics, or diagnostics unless a separately documented and justified owner-approved exception applies.
The system MUST associate each provider-derived result with the provider identity, lookup time, and provider result/version metadata when supplied by that provider.
The system MUST validate provider responses against the selected provider's documented response contract before using them to produce a user-visible result.

The system MUST distinguish a provider-confirmed match, no known match, suspicious/ambiguous result, and unavailable or inconclusive lookup whenever the selected provider and approved result policy support those distinctions.
The system MUST NOT describe a URL as absolutely safe, guaranteed harmless, or free of threats solely because a provider reports no known match.
statements.location: ### Requirement ZD-WEB-022 — No absolute safety claim

statements.text: The system MUST expose the lookup time and any provider-supplied freshness/expiry information used to determine whether a result may be reused.

The system MUST represent provider outage, timeout, DNS failure, connection reset, quota rejection, rate limiting, and service unavailability as failed or inconclusive states rather than a no-threat result.
The system MUST apply an explicit retry policy that cannot bypass current entitlement, owner activation, URL safety, rate limits, or request budgets.
The system MUST expose cancellation where the active platform and request lifecycle can support it and MUST distinguish a cancelled request from a completed result.
The system MUST enforce configurable per-account and service-level usage limits before provider dispatch, with limit exhaustion producing a no-call outcome.
statements.location: ### Requirement ZD-WEB-027 — Rate and quota policy

statements.text: The system MUST prevent repeated, automated, or bulk requests from bypassing account-level and service-level usage controls or either MVP-03 eligibility gate.
The system MUST stop initiating new provider requests when owner-controlled activation becomes disabled, including queued, retried, redirected, or not-yet-dispatched work.
The system MUST stop initiating new provider requests when Pro entitlement expires, is revoked, or can no longer be positively verified.

The system MUST enforce explicit limits for request duration, response size, redirect depth, concurrency, and decompressed/expanded content before those limits can cause unbounded resource consumption.

The system MUST present distinct supported states for blocked, queued, processing, completed, inconclusive, failed, and cancelled requests, without representing a blocked or failed request as completed.
The system MUST NOT imply that cross-device check history or durable URL retention is available unless an owner-approved retention and persistence policy has been adopted and implemented.
The system MUST apply a documented owner-approved retention and deletion policy to any stored submitted URL, result, or provider response before persistent storage is enabled.
The system MUST account for every provider dispatch against the applicable entitlement, usage and service budget, including retries and redirected requests.

The system MUST make provider outages, abnormal error rates, unexpected usage growth, and repeated gate-denial or abuse patterns observable to authorized operators without exposing full submitted URLs by default.
The system MUST preserve the same eligibility, no-call, result-meaning, and privacy semantics on web and Android even when input mechanisms or supported capabilities differ.
The system MUST NOT use MVP-03 as a general-purpose URL fetcher, crawler, website auditor, port scanner, or network-reconnaissance interface.

requirements.subject: Pro eligibility
requirements.rationale: Owner decision ZD-SCOPE-001: Pro entitlement is a mandatory independent gate.

basis.description: Direct encoding or operational consequence of owner-approved decision ZD-SCOPE-001.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a request is made by an account with active Pro entitlement
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user submits a website/link check
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is eligible for gate evaluation only in the active case; otherwise it is blocked without a provider call

requirements.subject: Owner activation
requirements.rationale: Owner decision ZD-SCOPE-001: owner-controlled activation is a separate mandatory gate.

basis.description: Direct encoding or operational consequence of owner-approved decision ZD-SCOPE-001.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the owner activation switch is enabled or disabled
acceptanceCriteria.when: a user requests an MVP-03 check
acceptanceCriteria.then: the switch state is evaluated independently of Pro entitlement

requirements.subject: No-call invariant
requirements.rationale: Owner decision ZD-SCOPE-001 establishes the two mandatory gates and no-call rule; PM inference extends this invariant to unknown/unavailable states and every execution path.

basis.description: Direct encoding or operational consequence of owner-approved decision ZD-SCOPE-001.

acceptanceCriteria.given: either gate is false, unknown, stale, unavailable, revoked, or disabled before dispatch
acceptanceCriteria.when: any synchronous, retry, redirect, queued, cached-refresh, batch, fallback, or background path attempts dispatch
acceptanceCriteria.then: no provider/API request is emitted; the decision and reason are recorded without sensitive URL content

requirements.subject: Pro is bounded
requirements.rationale: Owner decision ZD-SCOPE-001 explicitly says Pro does not mean unlimited usage.

basis.description: Direct encoding or operational consequence of owner-approved decision ZD-SCOPE-001.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Pro user has reached an applicable usage limit
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is denied or deferred according to configured policy; no provider call occurs

requirements.subject: User initiation
requirements.rationale: PM inference from MVP-03 scope; automatic/background checking is excluded by the Phase 6 plan.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: no check is currently running
acceptanceCriteria.when: the user explicitly submits one URL for checking
acceptanceCriteria.then: exactly that submitted URL enters the request lifecycle

requirements.subject: Single URL scope
requirements.rationale: PM inference; existing product planning says URL checking is a single-URL lookup unless more scope is approved.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a user submits a URL on a page with links or embedded resources
acceptanceCriteria.then: the result identifies the checked URL only and makes no whole-site inspection claim

requirements.subject: Input validation
requirements.rationale: PM inference; parser/library and exact accepted URL policy remain open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the submitted value is empty, malformed, or unsupported by the currently configured URL policy
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is rejected with an actionable reason and zero provider calls

requirements.subject: Submitted and normalized identity
requirements.rationale: PM inference; exact normalization semantics require evidence and owner policy.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a submitted URL is transformed for lookup
acceptanceCriteria.when: the system records or displays the check
acceptanceCriteria.then: the original submitted value remains distinguishable from the normalized lookup target, subject to privacy controls

requirements.subject: URL credentials
requirements.rationale: PM inference based on data-minimization and credential-exposure risk.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the submitted URL contains user-info credentials
acceptanceCriteria.when: the request is prepared for provider lookup
acceptanceCriteria.then: credentials are removed or the URL is rejected; no credentials are disclosed to the provider

requirements.subject: Destination safety
requirements.rationale: PM inference; precise address classification and policy require security design and validation.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a URL resolves or redirects to a prohibited destination
acceptanceCriteria.when: the system considers dispatch or follows a redirect
acceptanceCriteria.then: the destination is blocked before network access to that destination

requirements.subject: DNS rebinding
requirements.rationale: PM inference; implementation mechanism intentionally unspecified.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a hostname resolves to an allowed address during initial validation and a prohibited address at connection time, or its answer changes during redirects/retries
acceptanceCriteria.then: no connection is made to the prohibited address

requirements.subject: Address representation
requirements.rationale: PM inference; precise canonicalization policy remains open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the input uses an alternate address or hostname representation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the same destination policy is applied; ambiguous representations are rejected rather than bypassing controls

requirements.subject: Redirect control
requirements.rationale: PM inference; redirect support and hop limits remain open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider or permitted fetch path returns a redirect
acceptanceCriteria.then: disallowed destinations and gate failures stop the chain before another outbound request

requirements.subject: Scheme downgrade
requirements.rationale: PM inference; no downgrade exception is currently approved.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a secure URL redirects to an insecure scheme
acceptanceCriteria.then: the redirect is rejected and no insecure destination request occurs

requirements.subject: TLS validation
requirements.rationale: PM inference; TLS implementation choice remains open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider connection presents an invalid, expired, mismatched, or untrusted certificate
acceptanceCriteria.then: the lookup fails safely; certificate verification is not bypassed

requirements.subject: Minimum disclosure
requirements.rationale: PM inference; provider-specific payload cannot be fixed until selection.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider lookup is eligible and a provider contract is selected
acceptanceCriteria.then: only documented minimum required fields are sent

requirements.subject: URL sensitivity
requirements.rationale: PM inference; URLs can contain tokens, identifiers or private resource names.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a URL is submitted or processed
acceptanceCriteria.when: the system handles, transmits, stores, logs, or displays it
acceptanceCriteria.then: the URL receives privacy protections and is not assumed public merely because it is a URL

requirements.subject: Logging redaction
requirements.rationale: PM inference; detailed telemetry policy remains open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a check generates operational telemetry
acceptanceCriteria.then: sensitive URL components and secrets are omitted or redacted

requirements.subject: Provider provenance
requirements.rationale: PM inference; provider selection unresolved.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider returns a result
acceptanceCriteria.when: the result is presented or retained
acceptanceCriteria.then: its provenance and lookup timestamp are available to the product's result semantics

requirements.subject: Provider response validation
requirements.rationale: PM inference; provider schema depends on later provider selection.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider response is malformed, incomplete, unexpected, or contains untrusted fields
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is rejected or represented as unavailable/inconclusive; it is not treated as a clean result

requirements.subject: Result uncertainty
requirements.rationale: PM inference; exact taxonomy and mapping are unresolved.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider response or lookup failure is received
acceptanceCriteria.then: the user sees the supported outcome and its limitations; absence of a match is not stated as proof of safety

requirements.subject: No absolute safety claim
requirements.rationale: PM inference grounded in honest, bounded result semantics.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider reports no known match
acceptanceCriteria.then: the wording states only that no known match was returned within the stated provider/check scope

requirements.subject: Freshness
requirements.rationale: PM inference; cache policy and freshness threshold remain open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a result is reused or displayed after its original lookup
acceptanceCriteria.then: the lookup time and applicable freshness limitation are visible or otherwise disclosed

requirements.subject: Provider outage
requirements.rationale: PM inference.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: any listed provider/network failure occurs
acceptanceCriteria.then: the result is not converted into a clean/no-match verdict

requirements.subject: Retry safety
requirements.rationale: PM inference; retry count/backoff remain open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a retry is considered after failure or interruption
acceptanceCriteria.when: the retry is scheduled or dispatched
acceptanceCriteria.then: all gates and safety policies are re-evaluated; if not satisfied, zero provider calls occur

requirements.subject: Cancellation
requirements.rationale: PM inference; actual cancellation boundary depends on provider/platform.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a user cancels an in-progress check
acceptanceCriteria.then: no further eligible work is initiated for that request and the state is reported truthfully; already-sent requests are not falsely claimed recalled

requirements.subject: Rate and quota policy
requirements.rationale: PM inference; numeric limits and reset semantics are open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a user or service has exhausted an applicable limit
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is blocked before provider dispatch and the applicable limit state is communicated

requirements.subject: Abuse resistance
requirements.rationale: PM inference; anti-abuse thresholds and controls remain open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a client repeats requests, alters request parameters, or attempts concurrent submissions
acceptanceCriteria.then: the applicable gates and limits are enforced server-side for each provider dispatch

requirements.subject: Activation change
requirements.rationale: PM inference extending owner-approved activation gate.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: activation is disabled while requests are pending or being prepared
acceptanceCriteria.when: a pending operation reaches its next dispatch boundary
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is cancelled or blocked before any subsequent provider call

requirements.subject: Entitlement revocation
requirements.rationale: PM inference extending owner-approved Pro gate.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: entitlement expires, is revoked, or becomes unverifiable during a workflow
acceptanceCriteria.when: a pending operation reaches its next dispatch boundary
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is blocked before any subsequent provider call

requirements.subject: Resource bounds
requirements.rationale: PM inference; numeric values must be established before release.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a request approaches or exceeds a configured resource bound
acceptanceCriteria.then: processing stops safely at the applicable bound and reports a bounded failure

requirements.subject: Lifecycle truthfulness
requirements.rationale: PM inference.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a request enters any supported lifecycle state
acceptanceCriteria.then: the displayed state matches the recorded request outcome

requirements.subject: History policy
requirements.rationale: PM inference; history and retention are unresolved and standalone history is not approved.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a result is completed or the user views prior checks
acceptanceCriteria.when: the product offers or describes history
acceptanceCriteria.then: only actually supported retention and access are represented; no unapproved history promise is made

requirements.subject: Retention and deletion
requirements.rationale: PM inference; exact schedule, data classes and deletion obligations remain open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the product proposes to persist URL or result data
acceptanceCriteria.when: persistence is enabled or a deletion request is processed
acceptanceCriteria.then: storage is not enabled without the policy; once enabled, deletion follows its documented scope and exceptions

requirements.subject: Provider accounting
requirements.rationale: PM inference; provider cost model and limits are unresolved.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a provider dispatch is attempted
acceptanceCriteria.when: the system records its accounting event
acceptanceCriteria.then: every actual dispatch is counted once and correlated to its request without storing the full URL in routine logs

requirements.subject: Incident visibility
requirements.rationale: PM inference; exact alert thresholds and operator workflow remain open.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: operational anomalies occur
acceptanceCriteria.then: signals identify the anomaly and affected service/account scope while respecting URL redaction

requirements.subject: Platform semantics
requirements.rationale: Owner-approved cross-platform identity direction; PM inference applies shared semantics to MVP-03.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a user performs the same eligible or ineligible check on either platform
acceptanceCriteria.when: the request is evaluated or a result is displayed
acceptanceCriteria.then: both platforms apply the same product policy and explain any platform-specific limitation

requirements.subject: No arbitrary fetch
requirements.rationale: Owner-approved MVP scope and explicit Phase 6 exclusion; PM inference operationalizes boundary.

basis.description: PM inference; no primary user research or selected provider contract is claimed.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a submitted URL or provider response could trigger crawling or arbitrary resource access
acceptanceCriteria.then: only the bounded, selected MVP-03 lookup occurs; no page traversal or unrelated network probing is initiated
